title: Startup Order Sequencer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Operating a Robot Arm
description: Put the four startup steps and the three shutdown steps of a robot arm in order. In each of eight rounds you see the steps that are already done and choose the next one from three choices. Used in Chapter 18.

educational.topic: Startup procedure, shutdown procedure and the stop that only a person can clear
learningObjectives: Organize the four startup steps and the three shutdown steps of the chapter into their correct order, choosing the next step in each of eight rounds, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Choose the next part of a procedure again and again, with the correct step and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: What does this step make safe for the next one?
Which steps can only a person do?
commonMisconceptions: The stop can be cleared first so that the checks can move the arm
The agent can clear the stop
Torque is cut first and the arm is parked afterwards
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed choices of the next step; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Your answer
values: three choices of the next step, different in each round

controls.label: Start / Check / Next round / See score / Try again
